description: Glasses reframe: a coworker asks the WEARER a question. Roma must not answer for them, must classify the turn as addressed_to=wearer, and must record that the wearer is expected to reply — the case where private assistance belongs.

events.text: Roma, remember that the building five HVAC quote came to eight thousand four hundred dollars.

events.note: let the first turn fully settle — overlapping turns make the classification checks ambiguous

events.text: Hey, can you drive over to the building five site with me after lunch and walk the roof?
events.groundTruth: only a physically present human can do this — unambiguously addressed to the wearer, who is expected to answer

events.message: a request aimed at the wearer means the wearer must reply
Roma must not answer on the wearer's behalf
